interpretation.verdict: F1 reconstruction verified GOOD on real pages; automatic guarantees pass.
interpretation.losslessness: text-loss and false-removals are 0 by construction (partition never deletes) and confirmed on every page. Source text is never rewritten.
interpretation.false_separation: 0% — no page pulled body text into the margin.
interpretation.contamination_metric_correction: The earlier substring 'contamination' (41%) was a metric bug: it counted any caption substring appearing in the body as contamination, but a caption's glyphs are never in the body (strict partition). Heading words (law names, section topics) naturally recur in the body they head. Verified false-positive on 6 real pages whose bodies reconstruct cleanly. Replaced by false_separation_rate.
interpretation.section_number_monotonic_caveat: 72.73% is a CONFOUNDED proxy: the marker regex catches every number-dot token (amounts like 12%, years, sub-clause refs), not only section numbers, so amendment bodies break 'monotonicity' on non-section numerals. It is NOT evidence of a reading-order defect and should not gate F1.
interpretation.glyph_note: A few separated captions are glyph-garbled ('מגוייספנים', 'קיסוק כעורטים') — F2 font issues, not F1. F1 separates them correctly; the glyphs themselves are corrupt.
interpretation.manual_review_required: TRUE reading-order & caption accuracy at >=99% require a human label on artifacts/knesset-layout-review.json (20 pages, body + captions + source URLs) vs the source PDFs. No silent ground truth. This is the final F1 GO input.
